_help: Har entry: [x, y, size] (chauthi value 'over' ho to logo gehre rang wali seal par bhi saaf dikhta hai) = stamp ka center (0-1, page ki width/height ka hissa) aur logo ki chaudai (page width ka hissa). Key = certificate ka naam (id), ya kisi ek page ke liye 'classification-3'. Jis certificate ki entry nahi hogi usme neeche-baayen default jagah par logo lagega.
